pages.text: Lava can set nearby wood alight without touching it. The pattern remembers that chance ignition.

pages.title: Shaping the Pattern
pages.text: Use a sample at the center of a blank mimic, with these materials around it:$(br2)Lava Bucket$(br)Oak Planks$(br)Rune Plate: Material Manifestation$(br)Rune Plate: Burning and Affliction$(br)Rune Plate: Numbers and Chance
